Name: Z-Energy Reflection
Effect: Z-Move. Shield Move. Charge. The User receives 3 less Damage from all attacks until its next Action. On its next Action roll the same Damage Pool as all attacks the User has been hit by plus 2 Extra Dice. Ignore the Target’s Defenses.
Description: An energy barrier forms around the User, absorbing energy from its Targets attacks, before releasing it back at them.
